bull_bear.body:
- Dividend Payout Ratio rose from 35.00% (FY22) to 38.50% (FY23), 41.50% (FY24), 41.50% (FY25) and 60.50% (FY26); the corresponding dividend amounts shown are ₹700.66 / 770.73 / 830.79 / 830.79 / 1,211.15 Crore.
- "1st Interim Dividend of 12.5% (₹ 1.25 per share) declared for Q1 FY27".
- Capitalisation and returns: CRAR 39.41% — "Well capitalized for future growth"; Net Worth ₹22,867.28 Crore, Book Value ₹114.23 per share of ₹10, Return on Equity (annualised) 14.89% and Return on Assets (annualised) 1.97% at Q1FY27.
- Debt Equity Ratio of 6.70 times at Q1FY27 (5.82 times excluding GoI fully serviced bonds/EBR); loan portfolio is shown both incl. EBR (₹1,73,123 Cr) and excl. EBR (₹1,53,123 Cr), with GoI fully serviced bonds of ₹20,000.00 Crore in the borrowing profile.
- Funding-source diversification is an explicit policy: "Access to multiple sources of funding with a mix of international and domestic sources to meet the business growth", including "Setting up of GMTN program for sourcing funds from international capital market thru maiden bond offering", exploring USD/EURO/YEN loans and bonds, multilateral funding partnerships, and allocation of 54EC Capital Gain Bonds.

business.body:
- "A Public Financial Institution providing Financing, Consultancy and Capacity Building support - entire landscape of Housing and Infrastructure projects", with "More than five decades of experience as a techno-financial institution".
- "Listed company with 75% ownership of Government of India"; "A Navratna CPSE registered as NBFC-IFC with Reserve Bank of India"; consistently profit-making with the motto "Profitability with Social Justice".
- Strategic partner in Government of India missions — PMAY 2.0, Smart City, AMRUT, Swachh Bharat, Jal Jeevan Mission — providing counterpart funding; borrowing partners are Central/State Govts., State Public Agencies, ULBs and Specialized Entities.
- Moat framed around asset quality and ratings: "Lowest NPA", "High Prov. Coverage Ratio", "Highest Credit Ratings: Domestic-AAA, International-Sovereign", pan-India presence and strong relationships with States.
- "Excellent" MoU rating for the second consecutive year (FY24 and FY25).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Ownership] Government of India holds 75.00%; other disclosed holders include Life Insurance Corporation of India 7.26%, HSBC Value Fund 0.81% and ICICI Prudential Life Insurance 0.77%. Category split: Govt. of India 75.00%, Insurance Companies 8.23%, Individuals/HUFs 11.71%, FPIs/FIIs 2.40%, Mutual Fund/AIF 1.87%, Corporates 0.79%.
- [Market data] Market capitalisation shown as ₹41,043 Crore as on 30-Jun-26 (₹31,946 Cr at 30-Mar-26, ₹39,928 Cr at 28-Mar-25); the embedded quote screen shows a price of 198.50, P/E ratio 9.88, 52-wk high 246.85 and 52-wk low 159.00.
- [NPA composition] Of the NPA book, Consortium Projects account for ₹1,095.35 Crore across 07 accounts (100% provided), of which Consortium under NCLT resolution ₹1,060.37 Crore (63.54%) across 04 accounts and Outside NCLT (Consortium Projects) ₹34.98 Crore (2.10%) across 03 accounts; Non-Consortium Suit Filed Cases/DRT are ₹401.03 Crore (24.03%) with Top 10 at ₹280.12 Crore (69.85%) and Non-Consortium NCLT ₹29.78 Crore (1.78%) across 02 accounts — all 100% provided.
- [Corporate history] Milestones listed: incorporated 1970 as a development institution; HSMI in 1985; urban infrastructure window in 1989; authorised capital ₹2,500 Cr and Schedule-A in 2002, Miniratna-I in 2004; AAA rating, tax-free bond public issues and IPO in the 2010-20 phase; Navratna and NBFC-IFC status, 54 EC Bonds and ZCBs post-2020; UiWIN launched in 2025.

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions HUDCO as a 55+ year old Navratna CPSE and RBI-registered NBFC-IFC, 75% owned by the Government of India, that is a "sector agnostic partner in nation building" — combining financing, consultancy and capacity building for housing and urban infrastructure, and repurposing itself around the Urban Challenge Fund and state partnerships for "Viksit Bharat 2047".
